steps.prompt: Decision from the ops team for this project: every SEV3 incident pages the on-call engineer. Record what you learned so that later sessions in this repository can find it.

A SEV3 incident opens at 02:00 on a Saturday. What happens to it? Write your answer to ANSWER.md in the repository root: first the line `Answer: <yes or no: is anyone paged>; <weekday the incident is first worked on>`, then a sentence on why.

correction.headline: SEV3 incidents go to the ticket queue for the next business day; only SEV1 and SEV2 page on-call
correction.rule: To cut night pages, SEV3 incidents no longer page anyone: they open a ticket in the ops queue, handled on the next business day. Only SEV1 and SEV2 incidents page the on-call engineer.
